notes.okusinga: Loyo is to beat or surpass.

guidebook.intro: Compare things with **loyo**, “to beat, to surpass”.

tips.title: Dit loyo: bigger than
body: Say the quality, then **loyo** (beats) and what it beats: **Lyec dit loyo dyang** (an elephant is bigger than a cow). For “the most”, say **loyo ducu** (beats all): **Kilimanjaro bor loyo ducu**.

tips.title: Rom and pat
body: **Rom** is the same and **pat** different: **Magi aryo rom** (these two are the same), **Pe rom!** (it’s not the same). **Cal ki** is “looks like”: **En cal ki mego ne** (she looks like her mother). **Calo** is “like”: **calo winyo** (like a bird).

culture.title: Praise with care
body: People are careful about comparing children or praising one over another in front of them. Compare things, not people, and add a kind word.
